notes.title: Patch: Beta 0.1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shielded Rose enemies spin slower and have cooldown on damaging player
[*] If you shoot Exploder's knees it will turn into Exploding Crawler
[*] Exploders are bigger
[/list]
[b]Treasures:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added chance to spawn Treasures with Special Conditions
[/list]
[b]Traps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new traps that can spawn after defeating the first Boss
[*] All traps are more randomized (more places to spawn, different configurations, ...)
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing Bone Snake name in death statistics
[*] Fixed typo in welcome screen
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Visual changes to tutorial map
[/list]

notes.title: Patch: Beta 0.1.0.5 - Live Now!
notes.content:
v0.1.0.5
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sacrifice Card flickering
[*] Drain gun not resetting damage / not filling correctly
[*] Not showing multiple hints at once
[*] Mouse sensitivity not loading in new levels
[*] Killing enemies in reforge map with heart sacrifice no longer spawns orbs that give player souls
[/list]
[b]Reworked Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rose enemy reworked -> Shielded, replaced projectiles with laser strike
[*] Crawlers reworked to jump on player and damage them
[*] Exploders are faster, but will not charge the player unless they get close to them, they also shoot projectiles
[*] Head Cannon flies away from player when they get too close and tries to keep a medium distance from player
[/list]
[b]Sacrifices:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Lungs II. sacrifice -> Decreases max jump count
[*] Lungs sacrifice will not be active while interacting with cards and other interfaces
[/list]
[b]Guns and Totems:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hook Gun takes you closer to hook points
[*] Added Melee Attack Totem
[*] Hook Gun homing projectiles are no longer explosive
[/list]
[b]Movement:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can dash instead of sliding when in the air (at the cost of one double jump charge)
[/list]
[b]Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added camera lean intensity
[*] Added options to toggle Dash / Jump Blur, Blood on screen and Screen Distortion
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skipable death stats animation
[*] Gates leading into bonus levels are golden
[*] Recoloured Totems in HUB
[*] More waves in all stages
[*] Added one larger map for Stage III.
[*] Added randomized structures to some maps
[*] Traps spawn with visual warning
[/list]
